description: Travel time data of Chengdu road network is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Chen Gao, Hongliang Guo (University of Electronic Science and Technology of China). This dataset contains road network information of Chengdu with travel time data during four time slots: weekday peak hour, weekday off-peak hour, weekend peak hour and weekend off-peak hour. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
